import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", n_colors=len(df['brand'].unique()))
brand_colors = dict(zip(df['brand'].unique(), colors))

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                c=[brand_colors[brand]], label=brand, s=100, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Brand')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Price by Brand bar chart
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
brand_prices = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax2.barh(brand_prices.index, brand_prices.values, 
                color=[brand_colors[b] for b in brand_prices.index], edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Price (USD)')
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Brand')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 3. Sensor Type distribution
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=sns.color_palette("pastel"), explode=[0.05]*len(sensor_counts))
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution')

# 4. Weight vs Price scatter with body type
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
markers = ['o', 's', '^']
for i, body in enumerate(body_types):
    body_data = df[df['body_type'] == body]
    ax4.scatter(body_data['weight_grams'], body_data['price_usd'],
                marker=markers[i % len(markers)], s=100, label=body, edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)')
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax4.set_title('Weight vs Price by Body Type')
ax4.legend()
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Model Year vs Max ISO
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
ax5.bar(df['model_year'].astype(str), df['max_iso'], 
        color=sns.color_palette("viridis", n_colors=len(df)), edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year')
ax5.set_ylabel('Max ISO')
ax5.set_title('Max ISO by Model Year')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 6. Megapixels by Body Type boxplot
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
body_type_order = df.groupby('body_type')['megapixels'].median().sort_values().index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='body_type', y='megapixels', ax=ax6, 
            order=body_type_order, palette="Set2")
sns.stripplot(data=df, x='body_type', y='megapixels', ax=ax6,
              order=body_type_order, color='black', size=8, alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('Body Type')
ax6.set_ylabel('Megapixels')
ax6.set_title('Megapixels Distribution by Body Type')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
